paragraphs.en: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) helps with conducting forensics of mobile devices in order to find signs of a potential compromise.
paragraphs.zh: MVT（Mobile Verification Toolkit，移动设备验证工具包）可帮助对移动设备进行取证，以发现潜在入侵迹象。

paragraphs.en: We recently merged the "v3" branch. This introduced breaking changes. If you relied on mvt output in other scripts They might have broken. More details: #757
paragraphs.zh: 我们最近合并了「v3」分支。 这引入了一些破坏性变更。 如果你在其他脚本中依赖了 mvt 输出，它们可能已经失效了。更多详情：#757

sents.en: We recently merged the "v3" branch.
sents.zh: 我们最近合并了「v3」分支。

paragraphs.en: Mobile Verification Toolkit (MVT) is a collection of utilities to simplify and automate the process of gathering forensic traces helpful to identify a potential compromise of Android and iOS devices.
paragraphs.zh: 移动验证工具包（MVT）是一系列实用工具的集合，用于简化和自动化收集取证痕迹的过程，这些痕迹有助于识别 Android 和 iOS 设备可能遭受的入侵。

paragraphs.en: It has been developed and released by the Amnesty International Security Lab in July 2021 in the context of the Pegasus Project along with a technical forensic methodology . It continues to be maintained by Amnesty International and other contributors.
paragraphs.zh: 它由国际特赦组织安全实验室于2021年7月在飞马项目（Pegasus Project）的背景下开发并发布，同时附带了技术取证方法。 它目前仍由国际特赦组织及其他贡献者维护。

sents.en: It has been developed and released by the Amnesty International Security Lab in July 2021 in the context of the Pegasus Project along with a technical forensic methodology .
sents.zh: 它由国际特赦组织安全实验室于2021年7月在飞马项目（Pegasus Project）的背景下开发并发布，同时附带了技术取证方法。

sents.en: It continues to be maintained by Amnesty International and other contributors.
sents.zh: 它目前仍由国际特赦组织及其他贡献者维护。

paragraphs.en: Note MVT is a forensic research tool intended for technologists and investigators. It requires understanding digital forensics and using command-line tools. This is not intended for end-user self-assessment. If you are concerned with the security of your device please seek reputable expert assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，MVT 是一款面向技术人员和调查人员的取证研究工具。 使用它需要具备数字取证知识，并会使用命令行工具。 本工具并非供最终用户进行自我评估之用。 如果您担心设备的安全，请寻求信誉良好的专家协助。

sents.en: Note MVT is a forensic research tool intended for technologists and investigators.
sents.zh: 请注意，MVT 是一款面向技术人员和调查人员的取证研究工具。

sents.en: It requires understanding digital forensics and using command-line tools.
sents.zh: 使用它需要具备数字取证知识，并会使用命令行工具。

sents.en: This is not intended for end-user self-assessment.
sents.zh: 本工具并非供最终用户进行自我评估之用。

sents.en: If you are concerned with the security of your device please seek reputable expert assistance.
sents.zh: 如果您担心设备的安全，请寻求信誉良好的专家协助。

paragraphs.en: MVT supports using public indicators of compromise (IOCs) to scan mobile devices for potential traces of targeting or infection by known spyware campaigns. This includes IOCs published by Amnesty International and other research groups.
paragraphs.zh: MVT 支持使用公开的入侵指标（IOC）扫描移动设备，以查找被已知间谍软件活动定向攻击或感染的潜在痕迹。 这包括由国际特赦组织和其他研究组织发布的入侵指标（IOC）。

sents.en: MVT supports using public indicators of compromise (IOCs) to scan mobile devices for potential traces of targeting or infection by known spyware campaigns.
sents.zh: MVT 支持使用公开的入侵指标（IOC）扫描移动设备，以查找被已知间谍软件活动定向攻击或感染的潜在痕迹。

sents.en: This includes IOCs published by Amnesty International and other research groups.
sents.zh: 这包括由国际特赦组织和其他研究组织发布的入侵指标（IOC）。

paragraphs.en: Warning Public indicators of compromise are insufficient to determine that a device is "clean", and not targeted with a particular spyware tool. Reliance on public indicators alone can miss recent forensic traces and give a false sense of security.
paragraphs.zh: 警告：公开的失陷指标不足以判定某台设备是“干净的”，即未被特定间谍软件工具瞄准。 仅依赖公开的失陷指标可能会漏掉最新的取证痕迹，并造成虚假的安全感。

sents.en: Warning Public indicators of compromise are insufficient to determine that a device is "clean", and not targeted with a particular spyware tool.
sents.zh: 警告：公开的失陷指标不足以判定某台设备是“干净的”，即未被特定间谍软件工具瞄准。

sents.en: Reliance on public indicators alone can miss recent forensic traces and give a false sense of security.
sents.zh: 仅依赖公开的失陷指标可能会漏掉最新的取证痕迹，并造成虚假的安全感。

paragraphs.en: Reliable and comprehensive digital forensic support and triage requires access to non-public indicators, research and threat intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠且全面的数字取证支持和分类分诊需要访问非公开的指标、研究和威胁情报。

paragraphs.en: Such support is available to civil society through Amnesty International's Security Lab or through our forensic partnership with Access Now’s Digital Security Helpline .
paragraphs.zh: 民间社会可以通过国际特赦组织的安全实验室（Security Lab）或通过我们与 Access Now 数字安全热线（Digital Security Helpline）的取证合作获得此类支持。

paragraphs.en: More information about using indicators of compromise with MVT is available in the documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 有关在 MVT 中使用失陷指标的更多信息，请参阅相关文档。

paragraphs.en: MVT can be installed from sources or from PyPI (you will need some dependencies, check the documentation ):
paragraphs.zh: MVT 可以从源代码或 PyPI 安装（你需要安装一些依赖项，请查阅文档）：

paragraphs.en: pip3 install mvt You can also install MVT from PyPI with uv . First, install uv:
paragraphs.zh: pip3 install mvt 你也可以使用 uv 从 PyPI 安装 MVT。首先，安装 uv：

paragraphs.en: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh Then install MVT as a command-line tool:
paragraphs.zh: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh 然后将 MVT 安装为命令行工具：

paragraphs.en: uv tool install mvt For alternative installation options and known issues, please refer to the documentation as well as GitHub Issues .
paragraphs.zh: uv tool install mvt 如需其他安装方式及已知问题，请参阅文档以及 GitHub Issues。

paragraphs.en: MVT provides three commands: mvt-ios and mvt-android analyse acquisitions from devices of that platform, and mvt hosts what belongs to neither: version , completion , plugins and download-iocs ( version and download-iocs remain available on the platform commands for now). Running mvt on its own shows the installed version, update notices and the available commands. Check out the documentation to learn how to use them!
paragraphs.zh: MVT 提供三个命令：mvt-ios 和 mvt-android 用于分析来自相应平台设备的取证数据，而 mvt 承载不属于前两者的功能：version、completion、plugins 和 download-iocs（version 和 download-iocs 目前在平台命令中仍然可用）。 单独运行 mvt 会显示已安装的版本、更新提示以及可用的命令。 请查阅文档以了解如何使用它们！

sents.en: MVT provides three commands: mvt-ios and mvt-android analyse acquisitions from devices of that platform, and mvt hosts what belongs to neither: version , completion , plugins and download-iocs ( version and download-iocs remain available on the platform commands for now).
sents.zh: MVT 提供三个命令：mvt-ios 和 mvt-android 用于分析来自相应平台设备的取证数据，而 mvt 承载不属于前两者的功能：version、completion、plugins 和 download-iocs（version 和 download-iocs 目前在平台命令中仍然可用）。

sents.en: Running mvt on its own shows the installed version, update notices and the available commands.
sents.zh: 单独运行 mvt 会显示已安装的版本、更新提示以及可用的命令。

sents.en: Check out the documentation to learn how to use them!
sents.zh: 请查阅文档以了解如何使用它们！

paragraphs.en: Pass --verbose to any of the three commands, before the command name ( mvt-ios --verbose check-backup ... ), for debug output. The --verbose option the check-* commands accept after their name still works but is kept for compatibility only and will be removed in a future release.
paragraphs.zh: 将 --verbose 传递给这三个命令中的任何一个，放在命令名称之前（mvt-ios --verbose check-backup ...），即可获得调试输出。 check-* 命令在其名称之后接受 --verbose 选项仍然有效，但仅为保持兼容性而保留，并将在未来的版本中移除。

sents.en: Pass --verbose to any of the three commands, before the command name ( mvt-ios --verbose check-backup ... ), for debug output.
sents.zh: 将 --verbose 传递给这三个命令中的任何一个，放在命令名称之前（mvt-ios --verbose check-backup ...），即可获得调试输出。

sents.en: The --verbose option the check-* commands accept after their name still works but is kept for compatibility only and will be removed in a future release.
sents.zh: check-* 命令在其名称之后接受 --verbose 选项仍然有效，但仅为保持兼容性而保留，并将在未来的版本中移除。

paragraphs.en: MVT can generate a shell completion script for Bash, Zsh, and Fish which covers mvt , mvt-ios and mvt-android :
paragraphs.zh: MVT 可以为 Bash、Zsh 和 Fish 生成 Shell 自动补全脚本，涵盖 mvt、mvt-ios 和 mvt-android：

paragraphs.en: mvt completion The command prints setup instructions by default. To generate the completion script directly, pass the shell name:
paragraphs.zh: mvt completion 该命令默认会打印配置说明。 若要直接生成补全脚本，请传入 shell 名称：

sents.en: mvt completion The command prints setup instructions by default.
sents.zh: mvt completion 该命令默认会打印配置说明。

sents.en: To generate the completion script directly, pass the shell name:
sents.zh: 若要直接生成补全脚本，请传入 shell 名称：

paragraphs.en: mvt completion bash MVT only writes completion files or shell configuration when --install is passed. See the command completion documentation for details.
paragraphs.zh: mvt completion bash 只有在传入 --install 参数时，MVT 才会写入补全文件或 shell 配置。 详情请参阅命令补全文档。

sents.en: mvt completion bash MVT only writes completion files or shell configuration when --install is passed.
sents.zh: mvt completion bash 只有在传入 --install 参数时，MVT 才会写入补全文件或 shell 配置。

sents.en: See the command completion documentation for details.
sents.zh: 详情请参阅命令补全文档。

paragraphs.en: Plugin packages extend MVT with additional forensic modules, which run inside the check-* commands, and with top-level commands on mvt , mvt-ios and mvt-android . See the development documentation for writing and installing them, and the custom CLI command documentation for the entry points a package registers commands in.
paragraphs.zh: 插件包通过额外的取证模块扩展 MVT，这些模块在 check-* 命令中运行，并为 mvt、mvt-ios 和 mvt-android 提供顶层命令。 关于如何编写和安装插件包，请参阅开发文档；关于插件包在哪些入口点注册命令，请参阅自定义 CLI 命令文档。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of MVT is to facilitate the consensual forensic analysis of devices of those who might be targets of sophisticated mobile spyware attacks, especially members of civil society and marginalized communities. We do not want MVT to enable privacy violations of non-consenting individuals. In order to achieve this, MVT is released under its own license. Read more here.
paragraphs.zh: MVT 的目的是帮助对可能成为复杂手机间谍软件攻击目标的人群（尤其是公民社会成员和边缘化群体）的设备进行基于同意的取证分析。 我们不希望 MVT 被用来侵犯未表示同意的个人的隐私。 为实现这一目标，MVT 以其专属许可证发布。详情请见此处。
